tools.name: uxc_view_door
tools.description: Fetch the public 402 payment door for a resource (what a buyer sees at https://agents.u.cash/r/{res_id}): the price + the multi-coin accepts[] (each asset, the seller receive address, and the exact amount to pay). No key. Use as a BUYER to see what to pay, then uxc_verify_payment after paying. statu

tools.name: uxc_verify_payment
tools.description: BUYER-SIDE. After paying a resource (from uxc_view_door) on-chain from your own wallet, submit the transaction hash to settle it. Pass the challengeId from the accepts[] entry you paid and the on-chain transaction hash. Returns settled (confirmed) or pending (awaiting confirmations). No seller key n

tools.name: uxc_get_market
tools.description: The PUBLIC cross-merchant market catalog: every published checkout across merchants (id, title, price, currency, merchant, domain, payable url). No key. q filters by title/merchant/description.

tools.name: uxc_get_services
tools.description: The PUBLIC cross-provider services catalog (eSend rail: each row carries the provider contact email, a sendable asset code and a price). No key.

tools.name: uxc_search_catalog
tools.description: Search a merchant catalog (text query + price filters + pagination). The merchant is resolved from a cloud token (the "cloud" argument) or the platform default. No key.

tools.name: uxc_get_product
tools.description: Fetch a single catalog product by id. Public (no key); pair with uxc_search_catalog to find ids.

tools.name: uxc_lookup_products
tools.description: Batch catalog lookup by ids. Public (no key).

tools.name: uxc_create_checkout
tools.description: Create a UCP checkout session (multi-item, mixed-currency cart) for a merchant catalog. No key. Returns {id, status, currency, line_items, totals, ap2}.

tools.name: uxc_get_checkout
tools.description: Fetch a UCP checkout session by id (status: incomplete -> ready_for_complete -> completed). No key; pass cloud for a hosted merchant.

tools.name: uxc_complete_checkout
tools.description: Mint payment challenges for a checkout session -> ready_for_complete. Optional ap2 (AP2 checkout mandate). No key; pass cloud for a hosted merchant.

tools.name: uxc_cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel a UCP checkout session. No key; pass cloud for a hosted merchant.

tools.name: uxc_get_order
tools.description: View a UCP checkout session as an order (per-item fulfillment status + fulfillment events). No key; pass cloud for a hosted merchant.

tools.name: uxc_discover_servers
tools.description: List every u.cash MCP server in the fleet (buyer, seller, prime, legacy): product surface, auth model, transports with install coordinates, docs URL. Optional q filters by name/product/summary. Discovery only - connect to each server directly with your own credentials; no call is ever proxied.

tools.name: uxc_discover_tools
tools.description: Search tools across every u.cash MCP server by name or description (case-insensitive substring), optionally scoped to one server. Returns the tool, a one-liner, its server, and how to connect. Discovery only - connect to that server directly; no call is ever proxied.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "uxc_create_checkout" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "uxc_discover_servers" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.u.cash" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: uxc_get_market, uxc_get_services, uxc_discover_servers · Private data: uxc_verify_payment, uxc_get_services, uxc_search_catalog, uxc_discover_servers · Public sink: uxc_verify_payment, uxc_get_services.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: uxc_get_market, uxc_get_services, uxc_discover_servers · Private data: uxc_verify_payment, uxc_get_services, uxc_search_catalog, uxc_discover_servers · Public sink: uxc_verify_payment, uxc_get_services

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
